hero.heading: Finance that’s easier to access, when you need it most.
hero.ctaCardText: BDC Capital Private Limited is an RBI-registered NBFC committed to accessible, transparent, and customer-first approach.

productsSection.sectionText: From personal requirements to business growth, discover loan solutions designed to support you at every stage.

products.title: Personal Loan
products.ctaCardText: Flexible funding support for personal requirements, assessed responsibly and transparently.

products.title: Business Loan
products.ctaCardText: Credit solutions to support business growth and working capital needs, assessed on a case-to-case basis.

products.title: Housing Loan
products.ctaCardText: Financing solutions for residential property requirements, subject to assessment and verification.

products.title: Vehicle Loan
products.ctaCardText: Funding support for the purchase of new or used vehicles, based on eligibility and assessment.

products.title: Loan Against Property
products.ctaCardText: Secured loan solutions against residential or commercial property, subject to evaluation.

products.title: Cash Credit Facility
products.ctaCardText: Working capital solutions designed to support day-to-day business operations and short-term funding needs.

whySection.sectionText:
A lending approach built around clarity, 
 responsibility, and trust.

whyChooseCards.title: Case-Based Evaluation
whyChooseCards.description: Each application is assessed individually, based on the applicant’s profile and requirements.

whyChooseCards.title: Transparent Process
whyChooseCards.description: Clear communication at every stage, from application to assessment and next steps.

whyChooseCards.title: Focus on Underserved Segments
whyChooseCards.description: Improving access to formal credit for individuals and businesses that may face limitations with traditional lenders.

whyChooseCards.title: Guided Support Throughout
whyChooseCards.description: Our team assists applicants through the process, helping them understand requirements and next steps.

process.title: Case-Based Evaluation
process.description: Each application is assessed individually, based on the applicant’s profile and requirements.

process.title: We review and connect with you
process.description: Our team reviews your details and reaches out within 48 working hours.

process.title: Documentation & next steps
process.description: Required documents are collected, followed by assessment and guidance on the next steps.

emiCalculatorSection.sectionText: Estimate your monthly EMI before you apply. Just enter the loan amount, interest rate, and tenure.

conclusionSection.sectionText: BDC Capital Private Limited, was founded to make formal credit simple and accessible. Today, as a responsible NBFC, we offer customer-focused loan solutions built on transparency, fair practices, and long-term trust.

footerContent.heading: Get started
footerContent.description: Share basic details and our team will guide you through the next steps.
